units.source_text: 南殿上方，为冷泉帝与朱雀院设两个御座，主人源氏的座位设在下方。

en.t: In the upper part of the southern hall, two imperial seats were prepared for Emperor Reizei and the Suzaku Retired Emperor, while the host Genji's seat was placed below.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝降旨请源氏同列。

en.t: Emperor Reizei issued an imperial command inviting Genji to sit in the same rank.

units.source_text: 如此优待，在源氏已极光荣。

en.t: Such special treatment was already an extraordinary honor for Genji.

units.source_text: 但冷泉帝犹有遗憾，以为未尽应尽之礼。

en.t: Yet Emperor Reizei still felt regret, thinking that he had not fully shown the courtesy that was due.

units.source_text: 左近卫少将捧了湖中取得的鱼，右近卫少将捧了藏人所的饲鹰人从北野猎得的一对鸟，从正殿东边来到御前，跪在阶前奉献。

en.t: The Left Minor Captain of the Guards carried fish taken from the lake, and the Right Minor Captain of the Guards carried a pair of birds hunted at Kitano by the falconers of the Chamberlain's Office; they came before the sovereign from the east side of the main hall, knelt at the steps, and presented them.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝便命太政大臣以此二物调制御膳。

en.t: Emperor Reizei then ordered the Chancellor to have the imperial meal prepared from these two offerings.

units.source_text: 诸亲王和公卿的飨宴，则由源氏办理，尽是山珍海味，格式迥异寻常。

en.t: The banquet for the princes and high nobles was arranged by Genji, and it was filled with delicacies from mountain and sea, in a form quite unlike the ordinary.

units.source_text: 日色将暮，诸人皆醉，即宣召乐人前来奏乐。

en.t: As the daylight was about to fade and everyone had grown drunk, musicians were summoned to come and perform.

units.source_text: 不取正式大乐，但选富有趣味之舞曲，令诸殿上童都来舞蹈。

en.t: They did not choose the formal grand music, but selected graceful and interesting dance pieces and had all the young pages of the court come out to dance.

units.source_text: 此时令人回想起从前桐壶帝行幸朱雀院举办红叶贺之事。

en.t: At this moment people were reminded of the former occasion when Emperor Kiritsubo visited the Suzaku Palace and held the Festival of Autumn Leaves.

units.source_text: 演奏舞曲《贺皇恩》之时，太政大臣家的男儿年方十岁，舞蹈姿态优美之极。

en.t: When the dance piece 'Gratitude for Imperial Grace' was performed, the Chancellor's son, only ten years old, danced with surpassing elegance.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝从身上脱下御衣来赏赐他。

en.t: Emperor Reizei took off an imperial robe he was wearing and bestowed it on him as a reward.

units.source_text: 太政大臣就代替儿子拜舞道谢。

en.t: The Chancellor then performed a ceremonial bowing dance in thanks on behalf of his son.

units.source_text: 主人源氏回思当年在红叶贺中与太政大臣共舞《青海波》时的情状，便命折取菊花一枝，送交太政大臣，并赠诗云：

en.t: The host Genji thought back to the time at the Festival of Autumn Leaves when he had danced 'Blue Sea Waves' together with the Chancellor, so he had a branch of chrysanthemums broken off and sent to the Chancellor, along with a poem:
